text:
mike: Quick async standup — SLOs / alerts / oncall follow-ups

mike: Yesterday — finished the hotfix to reduce CPU spikes on transformer-serving pods; rolled to prod at 02:15 UTC. Observed 18% lower p95 token latency in canary.
leila: Nice — saw the canary graphs, p95 drop looks solid. Any fallout on batching behavior?
mike: No visible batching regressions. I patched the batching window calc (`batcher/window_ms`) and added a safety cap. Code: `if (window_ms > 200) window_ms = 200;`
anya: Blockers — I'm still blocked by noisy 503s hitting the redis cache from a subset of requests. Haven't found a reproduction locally.
riley: I triaged a few of those 503s during the night. Looks like a client-side retry storm causing connection saturation to the replica. I added a temporary rate-limit rule at the LB for that route.
anya: Thanks — can you drop the rule name so I can reference it in the alert?
riley: Rule name: `rl-lb-chunked-uploads-v2`. Also updated the alert config: `SRE/Cache-503s` now triggers at 5/min per region instead of 1/min to reduce noise.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Updated alert `SRE/Cache-503s` — threshold changed by riley.
leila: FYI, on SLOs: we are still 99.6% for response_time.global.p95 — need 99.8. Mike, your fix should help; can we schedule a follow-up measurement in 24h?
mike: Yep — I'll re-run the traffic replay tonight and post results in morning.
anya: Oncall follow-up: pager for `INFER-CPU-THROTTLE` triggered twice; both were during the canary window. I added a note in the incident ticket: `likely transient, linked to rollout`.
riley: Filed a small runbook update: if `INFER-CPU-THROTTLE` spawns more than 3 pages in 6h, auto-scale policy should be inspected: see runbook `runbooks/inference/cpu-throttle.md` (internal link).
leila: Can somebody ping platform for longer-term mitigation (kernel-level preemption flags)? I think infra wants a heads-up before we change kernel params on dedicated nodes.
mike: I'll loop in platform in #eng-platform and tag @oliver for kernel preempt suggestion.
anya: Quick ask — can reviewers look at my PR #642 (redis retry backoff)? It's blocking the operator change. Short reviewers: riley, mike?
riley: On it — will try to review before EOD.
ops-bot: schedule-bot: Reminder — SLO review sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Join link: https://meet.redwood/slo-review
leila: Notes for tomorrow's sync: 1) p95 improvements post-hotfix 2) alert threshold tuning 3) runway for oncall rotation next sprint.
mike: Closing notes — will post the replay results + grafana dashboard link in this thread after the run. :thumbsup:
